title: Using OpenRouter with Kilo Code | Unified AI API

facts.fact: OpenRouter is described by Kilo as an AI platform giving access to many language models from different providers through a single API.
facts.quote: OpenRouter is an AI platform that provides access to a wide variety of language models from different providers, all through a single API.

facts.fact: To get an OpenRouter API key, users sign in to the OpenRouter website with a Google or GitHub account.
facts.quote: Sign in with your Google or GitHub account.

facts.fact: Kilo's docs state that OpenRouter's optional middle-out transform helps with prompts that exceed a model's maximum context size.
facts.quote: to help with prompts that exceed the maximum context size of a model.

facts.fact: In the Kilo Code VS Code extension, the OpenRouter middle-out transform is not available as a dedicated UI control and must be set in the kilo.json config file.
facts.quote: The middle-out transform is not exposed as a dedicated UI control in the VS Code extension.

facts.fact: In the Kilo Code VS Code extension, OpenRouter provider routing is not available as dedicated UI controls and must be set under the model's options in kilo.json.
facts.quote: Provider routing is not exposed as dedicated UI controls in the VS Code extension.

facts.fact: Kilo's docs state that OpenRouter charges based on the underlying model's pricing, with details on the OpenRouter Models page.
facts.quote: OpenRouter charges based on the underlying model's pricing.
